messages:
mia: FYI seeing a cluster of tiny inference pods stuck Pending in ap-southeast1 warmpool after last night's nvlink firmware rollout. About ~75 pods.

own: kubectl describe shows '0/10 nodes available: 5 node(s) had taints, 5 Insufficient gpu'. however `kubectl get nodes -l pool=warmpool-apse -o wide` shows GPUs free on several nodes.

mia: I grabbed a pod describe: `Warning FailedScheduling 1m default-scheduler 0/10 nodes are available: 5 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 5 node(s) are incompatible with pod's model affinity.`

kaito: incompatible how? we haven't changed model affinity in weeks. any new node labels after firmware?

own: nodes in rack-s7 now have label `nvlink.zone=isolated`. The scheduler extender consults compat-map which currently treats 'isolated' as NOT allowed for flavor `inference-small`.

mia: interesting: firmware rollout added the label via node-exporter metadata. That label wasn't present before so compat-map drop is now filtering nodes away.

kaito: quick mitigation: add 'isolated' to allowed_partitions for inference-small in ap-southeast1 only and reload the scheduler config. We should gate with a flag so it auto-expire in 6 hours unless promoted.

own: agreed. I'll submit a canary change: add `fallback_isolated: true` for region ap-southeast1 in infra/scheduler/compat-map. tagging @kaito for rollback watch.

ops-bot: PR #2107 opened: infra/scheduler/compat-map 10. Canary target: ap-southeast1.

mia: before changing, we need telemetry baseline: capture 5m p95 and node-level nvlink tx/rx errors.

own: baseline p95 gateway=110ms, nvlink rx err rate low.

kaito: canary merged to scheduler-canary and reloaded on apse-scheduler-0. cache synced.

mia: pods started scheduling into the previously isolated nodes. ~40 moved in 4m.

own: running descheduler nudge to gently rebalance remaining Pending pods.

kaito: monitor for cross-partition latency increase and NVLINK error counters. If we see >10% p95 regression or nvlink err spikes, rollback.

mia: after 15m: p95 115ms (small blip), nvlink errors steady. No SLOs breached.

kaito: follow-ups: 1) change compat-map to use soft-scoring for partition mismatch instead of strict deny 2) add an alert for allocatable vs physical GPU capacity divergence 3) update firmware rollout playbook to include label-change audit.

own: filing infra ticket INFRA-6123 to convert deny->score and add 6h auto-expire for region-specific fallbacks.

mia: closing once remaining 35 pods land and 30m no-regress. ops-bot, please create incident log.

ops-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1782 10 - Temporary compat fallback applied for ap-southeast1; auto-expire in 6h.

mia: final update: 75 -> 0 pending, p95 steady, closing thread. Thanks.
